programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 8 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            top, bottom = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            left, right = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            mt, mb = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            ml, mr = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            motif = [[grid[y][x] for x in range(ml,mr+1)] for y in range(mt,mb+1)]
            mh, mw = len(motif), len(motif[0])
            for y in range(top,bottom+1):
                for x in range(left,right+1):
                    out[y][x] = motif[(y-top)%mh][(x-left)%mw]
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-8e4e9619.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
